message.content:
I see. So `opj_j2k_read_tile_header` reads the SOT marker, then continues reading markers until SOD, then calls `opj_j2k_read_sod`. After `opj_j2k_read_sod`, it checks if it can use the TLM index to seek to the next tile-part.

But this TLM-based seeking only happens when `m_tile_ind_to_dec >= 0`. For the fuzzer, `m_tile_ind_to_dec` is -1 (no specific tile requested). So this block is skipped.

Let me continue reading to see what happens after `opj_j2k_read_sod`.
